title: Preliminary Proposal to Encode Pallava in Unicode
author: Anshuman Pandey
notes: L2/18-083. Contains proposed character repertoire for Pallava script encoding, with code chart, character names, and representative glyphs based on epigraphic sources.

title: Indische Palaeographie
author: Georg Bühler
notes: Foundational reference for Indian script palaeography. English translation: Indian Palaeography (1904, Appendix to Indian Antiquary).

title: Elements of South Indian Palaeography
author: Arthur Coke Burnell
notes: Comprehensive study of South Indian script development including Pallava, Grantha, and Vatteluttu. Second enlarged edition, 1878.

title: Epigraphia Indica
author: Archaeological Survey of India
notes: Multi-volume journal (1892–present). Essential primary source for inscriptional evidence of Pallava-era epigraphy across South India.

title: Early Tamil Epigraphy
author: Iravatham Mahadevan
notes: Comprehensive study of Tamil-Brahmi inscriptions with palaeographic charts. The standard reference for Tamil-Brahmi decipherment and classification.

title: The Unicode Standard — Grantha Block
author: Unicode Consortium
notes: Official Unicode code chart for Grantha (U+11300–U+1137F). Encoded in Unicode 7.0. Relevant for comparison with Pallava predecessor forms.

title: Indian Epigraphy and South Indian Scripts
author: Calambur Sivaramamurti
notes: Detailed study of South Indian script forms with comparative palaeographic tables. Originally published as Bulletin of the Madras Government Museum.

title: South Indian Inscriptions
author: Archaeological Survey of India
notes: Multi-volume series of published South Indian inscriptions, including Pallava-era records. Edited by E. Hultzsch, V. Venkayya, H. Krishna Sastri, and others.

title: Unicode Miscellaneous Symbols (U+2600–U+26FF)
author: Unicode Consortium
notes: Contains existing Western astronomical/astrological symbols. Critical for overlap analysis with proposed Indian astronomical symbols.
